# KLXPU (KUNLUNXIN XPU) v1-suite ignore list.
#
# Whole files/dirs that hang or wholly fail; merely-slow files are not listed
# here and run under the per-file wall-clock cap.
# One path per line, relative to the repo root; blank lines and # comments are
# ignored by the workflow.

# --- BKCL/XCCL single-communicator constraint: distributed runs deadlock
#     (overlapping TP/EP collectives, unbatched P2P, or mesh sub-group
#     all_to_all never progress) ---
tests/unit/v1/autotp/test_autotp_custom_patterns.py
tests/unit/v1/autotp/test_autotp_training.py
tests/unit/v1/autotp/test_tp_plan_e2e.py
tests/unit/v1/autotp/test_tp_plan_real_models.py
tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_autotp_sharded_attention.py
tests/unit/v1/ops/muon/test_muon.py
tests/unit/v1/ops/muon/test_per_head_muon_accelerator.py
tests/unit/v1/zero/test_offload_states.py
# Ulysses builds a 2x2 device mesh (SP + DP sub-groups) and runs
# all_to_all_single on a size-2 SP sub-communicator; intermittently deadlocks
# in the KLX comm stack (passes in isolation, hangs in-suite).
tests/unit/v1/sequence_parallelism/test_ulysses.py

# --- torch.compile intercepted by torch_xmlir (runs eagerly); DeepCompile/
#     Dynamo paths raise. Granular DeepCompile cases are deselected elsewhere ---
tests/unit/v1/ops/muon/test_muon_scale_compile.py

# --- Triton unsupported on klxpu: CUDA_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED ---
tests/unit/v1/ops/triton_ops
tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_fused_parity.py
tests/unit/v1/moe/test_autoep_permute_rows.py

# --- GDS needs GPUDirect Storage, unavailable here ---
tests/unit/v1/nvme/test_gds.py
